params.body:
## What this changes

The six fields a sale writes were spelled out eight times across five files:

- `OrderController` (four call sites)
- `OwnStockController::update_sold`
- `OwnStockList::markSold`
- `VehicleApiController::markAsSold`
- `App\Http\Helpers\Vehicle::buy_over`, twice: once on the vehicle being sold and once on the copy that goes to the buyer

Nobody owned the notion "sold". That is the soil X-97 grew in: `VehicleObserver` had to INFER that a vehicle was sold from which fields happened to be filled, because nowhere was it written down what a sale is.

`App\Support\Sale::sold($price, $extra = [])` is now that one place, with `Sale::unsold()` as its counterpart (the partner API can undo a sale, and the observer reads the transition between those two states, so they belong next to each other).

## Behaviour is identical

This is a move, not a redesign. Every call site writes the same fields, with the same values, through the same repository, so the model events keep firing exactly as they did and `VehicleObserver` sees the same transitions. The two shapes that differed keep their difference through `$extra`:

- the buy-over adds `send_to_modix => 0`
- one order path adds `expected_delivery_date`

The copy in `buy_over` still has `location_id` unset rather than written as null, as before: it is set from the shared definition and then unset on the line that always unset it, so a takeover copy gets no stock location.

## The tripwire

`SaleFieldsTest::test_no_other_place_writes_a_sale_by_hand` scans `app/` for a `sold_at` set to now next to a `sold` of 1, and fails if it finds one outside `Sale`. Without it this clean-up is a good intention that survives one PR. Checked by mutation: putting an inline sale back into `OwnStockList` makes it fail and names the file.

The other three tests pin what a sale writes (the six fields and no more), that a path may add and override fields, and that undoing a sale touches only the three sale fields and leaves the stock flags alone, since those may have been set by hand since.

## Scope

Nothing about the publishing path, the webhooks or the seal is touched. X-98 and X-99 stay open.

## Tests

Full suite: 709 tests, 2929 assertions, 1 skipped, the only failure `BuildStampTest`, a worktree artifact (`.git` is a file there, not a directory).
params.title: One place knows what selling a vehicle means
